narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks again, adventurer.  Here are your tickets!
narrative.requestItemsText:
That scorpid blood is working out great, adventurer! It's amazing how a little sparkle and shine can create a prized bauble out of an otherwise piece of junk. The patrons love the stuff, and love is what it's all about, don't you think...

You've been a big help to me, adventurer, and although I don't have a great need for more glowing scorpid blood, if you bring me more then I'll still trade you some tickets.
